facts: P17 height peak count derives peaks.len and phase-window membership from the same selected observations; independent expected two-passing-peaks remains review policy, not duplicate dynamic storage. Neighborhood absence is explicit unavailable.

P17 pose measurements share one LEGS roster and derive output directly from actual captured transforms; missing/degenerate geometry is unavailable. Body-local hip sign is used as an anatomical-side proxy for signed track/hemisphere; valid ownership of side in BoneRole versus arbitrary crossing/central hip coordinates needs producer admission/intent proof before a new mismatch is asserted.

P17 support slip derives actual world foot displacement with min adjacent support, excluding intentional turn adaptation and nonprocedural ownership. This differs from full-support anchored drift and body-relative continuity; shared length quantities do not justify merging those independent measurement contracts.
